text: Welcome to Python for AI Engineering. Before we write a single line of code, let's answer the question you're probably already asking: why Python, specifically?

It isn't an accident. Every major AI provider ships its official SDK in Python first. PyTorch and TensorFlow, behind nearly every modern AI model, are Python libraries at their core. Three reasons: readable syntax, a massive ecosystem, and first-class support — every provider builds for Python first.

Most AI engineering work isn't training models from scratch — that's a smaller, research-heavy specialty. Most of the job is integration: calling a model's API, shaping the data you send it, handling what comes back, and wiring it into a real application reliably.

This course assumes zero prior programming. Chapters 1 and 2 build the core language — variables, control flow, functions, error handling, and the data structures you'll use constantly to shape data for an AI API.
Every piece of this course earns its place because it shows up in real AI-engineering code. Next up: getting Python itself installed and your environment ready to write code.
